dict.string: SportsHub needs access to your health data to provide AI-powered recovery insights, performance predictions, and personalized training recommendations based on your biometric data.
SportsHub may update your health data with workout information.
SportsHub needs microphone access so you can talk to your AI Coach naturally, just like a real conversation.
SportsHub uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice into text when talking to your AI Coach.
SportsHub uses the camera so you can take a photo as evidence when submitting or disputing a match result.
SportsHub uses your location to find tennis courts near you. You can also search by city instead.
